import pandas as pd
print("done")
cs = pd.read_csv(r"")


print(cs.to_string())
# num --> convert str
cs.shape
cs.info()
cs.dtypes
cs.head(10) # top rows
cs.tail(10) # last 10 rows
#str la irukuradha int ah change panna mudiyadhu

cs.describe()

cs.columns

#duplicate value (cleaning process)

# null value

cs.duplicate() # false na duplicate ila true na duplicate iruku

cs.duplicate.sum() # count of duplicate

cs.drop_duplicates()

cs.isnull() #null value irulura place la true ilana false

cs.isnull().sum() #only null count

#unique value
cs["item"].unique()

#count wrong data

# all duplicate values like null,duplicate we need to check each cell

tr_count=0
i_count=0
q_count=0
u_count=0
t_count=0
p_count=0
l_count=0
d_count=0

#loc-->like index value
#iloc-->lable based value

for i in cs.index:
    if cs.loc[i,"transaction_id"]=="unk" or cs.loc[i,"transaction_id"]=="error":
        tr_count+=1
    if cs.loc[i,"item"]in["unk","error"]:
        i_count+=1
    if cs.loc[i,"Quantity"]in["unk","error"]:
        q_count+=1
    if cs.loc[i,"price per unit"]in["unk","error"]:
        u_count+=1
    if cs.loc[i,"total spend"]in["unk","error"]:
        t_count+=1
    if cs.loc[i,"ipayment method"]in["unk","error"]:
        p_count+=1
    if cs.loc[i,"Location"]in["unk","error"]:
        l_count+=1
    if cs.loc[i,"Transation date"]in["unk","error"]:
        d_count+=1
print(f"""
Transtion id {tr_count}
item {i_count}
quality {q_count}
price per unit {u_count}
total spend {t_count}
payment {p_count}
location {l_count}
transtion date {d_count}
""")

#fillna --> NA replace the value

# filling temp value nan,error,unk

for i in cs.index:
    if cs.loc[i,"item"]in["unk","error"]:
        cs.loc[i,item]="0"
cs.fillna({"item":"0"},inplace = True)
print("replace in item done")
